reference_review.redistribution: Repository-authored MIT OR Apache-2.0 generator and deterministic inputs. Python standard library only, in an isolated locked script environment, outside the product and ordinary CI; no upstream source is stored.
reference_review.limitations: The test data use deterministic sinusoids and a 0.1 sinusoidal noise term, so the estimator recovers the structural coefficients only approximately; the assertions are 0.03 bands. Agreement does not establish unbiasedness under other disturbances, and the tests' naive-contrast separation checks are properties of the sampled series, not derived here. No uncertainty or calibration claim.
